title: The EU Commission charges Temu with failing to cooperate during a December 2025 raid on its Dublin HQ as part of a probe into the company's foreign subsidies (Inti Landauro/Reuters)
summary: Inti Landauro / Reuters: The EU Commission charges Temu with failing to cooperate during a December 2025 raid on its Dublin HQ as part of a probe into the company's foreign subsidies — The European Commission said on Friday that it has charged Chinese online retailer Temu for not cooperating properly during a raid …
